basics.name: Pranaykumar Tirpude
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Earth Sciences at the University of Delaware studying Antarctic Ice Sheet dynamics, Pleistocene climate variability, and Ice-Rafted Debris (IRD) records using machine learning, isotope geochemistry, ice sheet modeling, and iceberg trajectory modeling.

work.name: University of Delaware
work.summary: Research on Antarctic Ice Sheet Dynamics across the Mid-Pleistocene Transition through high-resolution Ice-Rafted Debris records.
highlights: Deep learning-based instance segmentation of Ice-Rafted Debris from sediment core X-ray scans
Time-series analysis of IRD flux spanning approximately 1.4 million years
Development of ice sheet and iceberg trajectory models to investigate Antarctic ice sheet dynamics and IRD delivery to ice-distal locations
Antarctic IRD provenance studies using Strontium (Sr), Neodymium (Nd), and Lead (Pb) isotopes

work.name: NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research
work.summary: Research on linking Southern Ocean Ice-Rafted Debris flux with Antarctic Ice Sheet dynamics.
highlights: Simulated Antarctic ice sheet calving rates for modern and past climates using the Community Ice Sheet Model (CISM)
Generated iceberg size distributions from simulated CISM calving rates
Developed iceberg trajectory modeling including breakup of giant icebergs and meltwater distribution
Validated ice sheet and iceberg trajectory model outputs using radiogenic isotopic analyses of IRD grains

work.name: Indian Institute of Science
work.summary: Reconstruction of atmospheric CO₂ using boron isotope ratios in marine carbonates.
highlights: Performed species-level identification of foraminifera
Performed chemical cleaning and sample processing in a Class-100 clean laboratory
Operated ICP-OES and triple quadrupole ICP-MS instruments

volunteer.summary: Participated in public outreach activities demonstrating the significance of scientific ocean drilling and paleoclimate research.
highlights: Demonstrated the significance of scientific ocean drilling and paleoclimate studies to approximately 200 participants

volunteer.summary: Participated in public science outreach focused on microfossils and paleoclimate research.
highlights: Demonstrated the role of microfossils in paleoclimate research to students and the general public

projects.name: Antarctic Ice Sheet Dynamics Across the Mid-Pleistocene Transition
projects.summary: Investigation of Antarctic Ice Sheet dynamics using high-resolution Ice-Rafted Debris records from the Southern Ocean.
highlights: Deep learning-based instance segmentation of IRD from X-ray scans
High-resolution IRD flux reconstruction spanning approximately 1.4 million years
Time-series analysis of Antarctic IRD variability
Investigation of IRD delivery to ice-distal locations

projects.name: Ice Sheet and Iceberg Trajectory Modeling
projects.summary: Development of an integrated modeling framework linking Antarctic ice sheet calving, iceberg size distributions, iceberg trajectories, breakup, and meltwater distribution.
highlights: Community Ice Sheet Model (CISM) simulations of Antarctic calving rates
Generation of iceberg size distributions from modeled calving rates
Iceberg trajectory modeling for modern and past climates
Modeling breakup of giant icebergs and meltwater distribution
Validation using radiogenic isotope analyses of Antarctic IRD grains

projects.name: AI/ML-Based IRD Detection
projects.summary: Development of machine learning and deep learning approaches for automated detection and quantification of Ice-Rafted Debris in sediment core X-ray scans.
highlights: Deep learning-based instance segmentation
Automated IRD identification and counting
High-resolution IRD time-series generation

projects.name: Antarctic IRD Provenance Using Radiogenic Isotopes
projects.summary: Determination of potential Antarctic source regions of iceberg-rafted material using radiogenic isotope compositions of IRD grains.
highlights: Strontium (Sr), Neodymium (Nd), and Lead (Pb) isotope analysis
Sample preparation and chemical separation
Radiogenic isotope analysis of Antarctic IRD grains

projects.name: AI/ML-Based Sea Surface Temperature Reconstruction
projects.summary: Estimation of past sea surface temperatures using planktic foraminiferal assemblages from IODP Site U1457.
highlights: Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)
Support Vector Machines (SVM)
AdaBoost
Random Forest
Machine learning-based paleoclimate reconstruction

projects.name: Atmospheric CO₂ Reconstruction Using Boron Isotopes
projects.summary: Reconstruction of past atmospheric CO₂ using boron isotope ratios in marine carbonates.
highlights: Foraminifera identification
Class-100 clean laboratory sample processing
ICP-OES analysis
Triple quadrupole ICP-MS analysis

seagoing.name: SEALS 2025 – Sediment Exchange Along the Labrador Sea
seagoing.summary: Participated in a seagoing research expedition with 29 scientists from 12 institutions.
highlights: Conducted seawater sampling using a CTD rosette
Assisted with multi-corer and gravity coring
Conducted porewater sampling
Performed alkalinity titrations
Taught laboratory sections
Assisted students with hands-on laboratory activities, assignments, and course concepts
